A '''cloaking device prototype''' was developed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], and the refined technology was used to hide the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor's]] [[Emperor's Fortress|space fortress]] above [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. The prototype was kept in the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]], where Imperial [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] began working on cloaking [[Missile/Legends|missiles]] to create stealth weapons. It was the target of a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mission to Balmorra (Hunt for the Sith Emperor)|mission]] in [[3642 BBY]], as [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Warren Sedoru]] worked with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]] and crew to recover the device.
